desc: The 24-in. 800 Series smart dishwasher from Bosch comes with 16 place settings with 5 wash programs and 4 cycle options to choose from. The Energy Star certified dishwasher features a third rack system, PrecisionWash, and AquaStop Plus.
hl: We take much care of the quality of our dishwashers.
42 dBA -- the quietest dishwasher brand in the U.S.*
A range of technologies makes Bosch the quietest dishwasher brand in the U.S.* with impressively low decibel levels.
The Flexible 3rd Rack provides a versatile space for utensils
The Flexible 3rd Rack has expandable wings that easily lower to accommodate more of your deeper items.
Know when your dishwasher is running with InfoLight®

Based on our legendary sound reduction technology, our dishwashers are so quiet, we provide an InfoLight® that projects a red light onto the floor (or a white light in the pocket handle on select models) to signal that a cycle is running.
This Bosch Dishwasher is ENERGY STAR® certified and energy efficient
This Bosch dishwasher is ENERGY STAR® certified and meets or exceeds federal guidelines, for year-round energy savings
The deepest clean from PrecisionWash® with PowerControl™
PowerControl™ spray arm enhances PrecisionWash® performance to target your dirtiest dishes with a deeper clean, no matter where you load them on the bottom rack.
spec: Remote Start, Sanitize, Crystal Dry, ZoneControl™ Front, ZoneControl™ Back, ZoneControl™ Custom
Programs & Options Exclusive to Home Connect
Hand Wash, Energy Save, Half Load, Machine Care, Rinse
